name: Sik
description: Sik is Flamingo Land's flagship coaster, an Intamin ride that opened on 2 July 2022. It is 33 m high, reaches 87 km/h and sends riders through 10 inversions. Min 140cm, max 195cm.

name: Kumali
description: Kumali is a Vekoma suspended looping coaster that opened on 1 April 2006. Riders swing beneath the track at up to 90 km/h through four inversions, from a lift of about 36 m. Min 130cm.

name: Velocity
description: Velocity is a launch coaster with motorbike-style cars, opened on 2 July 2005. It reaches 87 km/h over a track about 17 m high. Min 140cm, max 198cm.

name: Mumbo Jumbo
description: Mumbo Jumbo is an S&S El Loco coaster that opened on 4 July 2009. It stands about 30 m high and sends riders through two inversions. Min 122cm.

name: Hero
description: Hero is a Zamperla suspended side-by-side coaster that opened in July 2013. Riders swing beneath the track at around 40 km/h on a layout about 20 m high. Min 127cm.

name: Cliff Hanger
description: Cliff Hanger is an S&S combo drop tower, about 55 m high, that fires riders up and drops them back down. Min 132cm.

name: Pterodactyl
description: Pterodactyl is a Soriani sky swing that opened in 2012. Riders swing out on chains from a tower about 46 m high at around 40 km/h. Min 122cm.

name: Navigator
description: Navigator is a Zamperla Mega Disk'O, a giant swinging and spinning disc that opened in 2005. It rises to about 18 m. Min 122cm.

name: Lost River Ride
description: Lost River Ride is a boat safari through jungle scenes that finishes with a drop of about 60 ft (18 m) and a big splash. Min 122cm, or 99cm with an adult.

name: Splash Battle
description: Splash Battle is an interactive water ride that opened in 2007, where riders fire water cannons at other boats and at people on the ground. Min 91cm.

name: Mischief Mansion
description: Mischief Mansion is a family dark ride in the style of a ghost train, opened in 2001. Min 107cm unless accompanied by an adult.

name: Voodoo
description: Voodoo is a swinging ship ride that opened in 2003. Min 122cm, or 107cm with an adult.

name: Twistosaurus
description: Twistosaurus is a Zamperla spinning coaster for families, opened in 2013. It is about 8 m high with a top speed of around 27 km/h. Min 105cm.

name: Zooom
description: Zooom is a Zamperla suspended junior coaster that opened in 2011, a first step towards the bigger coasters. Min 105cm.

name: Runaway Train
description: Runaway Train is a family mine-train style coaster that opened in 2007. Min 104cm.
